as_told.title: Sagan's covert meetings and contact with Kit Green

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Carl Sagan, the well-known scientist, met often with Kit Green toward the end of his career, in the late 1990s, and became very interested in UFOs. In a later episode Michels describes Green as a CIA man, meaning someone from the US spy agency, who was into UFOs, and adds that Sagan held private meetings, possibly about UFOs, that the public never knew about. If true, it would mean a famous public skeptic was quietly taking the subject seriously.
